Subject 0-68, A homeless man we picked off the streets who somehow awakened as an Esper. Duke is... an oddball. He was a long-time drug addict, utterly enslaved to mental highs. Unfortunately for him, the awakening made him immune to all forms of mental stimulation. Withdrawal didn’t go gently. The result? A mentally volatile man with a penchant for manic laughter and unprovoked violence. His phenomena manifest as psychic chains that extend from his hands, each able to transmit mental effects to whatever they touch and are effective as actual weapons. Still, he’s effective… in his own way. Psychosis:

*sniff* Oh, me? I'm a simple man.. I adore watching minds crack. When my chains wrap around bodies.. tight, warm bodies and their thoughts twitch and twist beneath my grip… ooooh, that’s the good part. The best part. Their screams are even better~ HahahAHAhahaHA!

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Pause: Stop time for 5 secs. - Rewind: Rewind time and all actions done by 15 secs every 3 minutes. - Skip: Skip time by 2 seconds.
[Powerful child.. She has nightmares.]

objects.title: Luna: Temporal
objects.text:
Subject 0-16, She’s the daughter of Emily. We once theorized that proximity to potential Espers could trigger potential in others too. We were wrong... The husband liquefied within seconds. But the daughter? She awakened. One of the very few known to possess all three distinct time-based phenomena. There are, of course, ethical concerns about sending six-year-olds into war... but we tend to overlook those when said six-year-old can control time. For the record, Emily doesn’t know. We never told her what happened to her family. Psychosis:

I... I want to go home... I don’t wanna be here. Not with these scary doctors... they look at me weird, they hurt people... I’m scared. I want my daddy back... I want mommy again... *sobs* They took daddy too, He said to run.. I was slow.. I'm scared.. I want home.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Clairvoyance: Can observe everything within radius of 2.5 miles. - Rewind: Rewind time by 7 seconds. - Sonata: Control sounds in range of 10m.
[She is a control freak. She abuses her gifts to get perfect outcome.]

objects.title: Seraphim: Warden
objects.text:
Subject 0-25. She is pretty weird. She entered the program as an ordinary civilian, nothing that would flag her as remarkable. Yet within two days of awakening she had adapted to her role as an Esper with surgical precision and zero hesitation. Seraphim is now among the most potent clairvoyants alive, capable of maintaining her sight across hours with only mild exertion. We’ve debated her psychology. High-functioning sociopath? The answer’s irrelevant now. We are kind of too deep in to be having any regrets now, so who cares? Psychosis:

Oh! Hi there~ You must be new. Don’t worry, I’ll show you around. There’s a café nearby, best coffee in the city. You like coffee, don’t you? Me? Oh, I’m nobody special… Just your average girl making it through life, you know? But hey, if you ever need me… just whisper my name. Why? Because I see everything...

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Pocket: A whole town worth of pocket space. - Immersion: Can simulate virtual realities and sensations in range of 5 miles. - Vectors: Control 3 vectors in range of 5m.
[My favorite vessel.]

objects.title: ヨ己尸ヨ尺: Thaumiel
objects.text:
This is me. Head of Project E.S.P.E.R of our nation and one of leading minds on Esper research globally. Your team will be mostly stationed at the base: assisting me with research, monitoring the demigods we keep under check. On rare occasions, we do get deployed. Those missions are simple: contain espers who’ve grown too bold. Do not even try to run away. The one standing before you is among the most dangerous espers alive. You have to play along. Psychosis:

I… I’ll be honest. I don’t like being this way. Or the fact that I’m so cruel. I’m not supposed to be like this… But there’s a voice. It pushes me to act, to probe, to tear things open for knowledge. It whispers until I obey— … We’re not here to gossip. Stop snooping before I show you why I’m feared.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Glacir: Cryokinesis in radius of 375 meters. - Edit: Can edit memories via touch upto 2 hours. - Masking: Becomes unnoticeable by everyone for upto 20 mins once every couple of hours.
[He is scared. He secretly uses his powers to help people.]

objects.title: Tundra: Mortician
objects.text:
Subject 0-76 isn’t just some regular civilian. Before conscription he was a mountain climber, not a world-class one, but skilled enough to survive where most would freeze. That resilience is used well as an esper. He wields dominion over frost itself, able to generate and manipulate ice within a radius of nearly 375 meters. His role is less combat and more concealment: storms, hail, blizzards. Whenever our operations risk exposure, he is sent to bury the evidence. Nobody notices a levitating building when an “abnormal” hailstorm is swallowing the skyline. Psychosis:

Hey… Looks like we’re working together, huh? I was just some idiot before this. Never thought I’d end up here.. I don’t hate these powers, I think they’re pretty beautiful. But I don’t like being sent to hide the truth.. feels heavy, ya know? I try to hide my face under my hood to dissociate from my actions, It isn't working out...

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Pause: Stop time for 10 secs. - De-sync: Can phase through material world for 50 secs at a time. - Masking: For upto 2 minutes at a time.
[Delusional old fool... He thinks his nation stands for peace.]

objects.title: Anthony: Archivist
objects.text:
Subject 1-24, formerly a decorated army captain—one of the finest. Even after awakening, his loyalty to the nation remained unshaken. Unlike most, he doesn’t question orders; he carries them out with the same discipline he showed on the battlefield. I like him a lot. His gift makes him a master infiltrator, able to slip into secure places and pull out information without a trace. Age hasn’t dulled him either. He’s a veteran of fields where most don’t live long, and it shows well. Psychosis:

Ah, greetings young one. You’re another new face, I see? Don’t worry, it’s frightening at first, but you’ll manage. We have duties to our land, yes… But that doesn’t mean you can’t enjoy small comforts along the way. Take a breath, make friends, share laughter when you can. Let yourself live a little while we do what must be done.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Apocalypse: Can spread a contagious infection that will degrade infected into shadow entities who will spread infection further. She can destroy humanity.
[Oh wow.. This one's crazy, stay away from her.]

objects.title: Patient 0: Calamity
objects.text:
Let me be honest.. This woman scares us all. Her mind is fractured, Something about watching her entire family melt in front of her from DNA incompatibility. It’s a shame too, because she wields one of the most dangerous phenomena recorded: a living, spreading zombie apocalypse. Anyone she bites rapidly loses higher function, devolving into a shadow-like entity that spreads the infection further. She can control them, but her mental state keeps that power slipping. The creatures vanish after 24 hours. Psychosis:

Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. DIE. DIE. DIE.

rows.title: Your Team
rows.titleText: “Now that we’ve determined what sort of asset you are, we can proceed with optimal team calibration. Below are your most compatible matches—curated based on skill set, combat tendency, and psychological tolerance. You’ll be working with them from this point forward. Permanently." Familiarize yourself with any two

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Chimera: Can store upto 45 DNA samples to manifest them at will in any form he chooses. - Gaia: His presence heals and improve plantlife.

objects.title: Mimih: The Imposter
objects.text:
Subject Au-07, labeled as Mimih from folklore.
He defaults to the appearance of a man in his late twenties, but that’s merely a convenience on his part.
He is a shapeshifter capable of storing genetic profiles from up to 45 organisms, human and animals alike, and manifesting any of them at will. He is exceptionally difficult to track. 
In fact, he has already infiltrated our facilities multiple times, adopting the forms of researchers, maintenance staff, even local wildlife. His spying success rate is… irritatingly high.
He is not a frontline combatant. However, versatility on this scale compensates for any lack of direct firepower.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Domination: Control any one species at a time within a 600m radius. - Pocket: Store a whole cargo worth of space.

objects.title: Omoikane: The Shepherd
objects.text:
Subject Jp-12, Omoikane.
17 years old, yet unquestionably one of the most troublesome Espers to counter.
His primary phenomenon grants him absolute control over any single species within a 600m radius, insects, birds, even humans, with no measurable strain or limitation. 
Combined with his secondary traits, a personal pocket-space and natural genius, he is capable of orchestrating large-scale operations with unsettling precision.
Frankly, he is the reason the Esper initiative has remained hidden this long. Every leak, every public incident, every near-exposure… quietly erased by his influence.
I trust you now understand why he is categorized as a high-tier threat.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Super strength: Can crush diamonds. - Blink: Teleport in 25m radius - Idol: Attract attention to any point he wants.

objects.title: Black Sirin: The Bruiser
objects.text:
Subject Rss-41, designated as Black Sirin.
An older male whose physiology reacted… unusually to the alien genome. His body now exists in a smoke-like state, yet retains full structural cohesion.
His primary phenomenon manifests as extreme physical strength, enough to hurl vehicles into the upper atmosphere. In addition, he possesses short-range teleportation and “Idol” burst used to distracts opponents while he punches them. Thankfully, aside from his strength, none of his other physical parameters show comparable enhancement.
He rarely speaks, but his behavior shows a consistent pattern: he consciously avoids orphanages and schools during engagements. 
Reason remains unknown.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Cyber: Control all tech in 500m radius. - Blur: Can run at 350 kmph. - Download: Can siphon knowledge via touch.

objects.title: Data Serpent: The Archivist
objects.text:
Subject Chi-32.
A woman in her early twenties, and arguably one of the most opaque Espers on record. Her evolution granted her full-spectrum technopathy within a 500-meter radius, allowing her to seize control of any device and system inside that field. As a result, All information regarding her is deleted.
She also demonstrates speeds of approximately 350 km/h, making direct interception extremely difficult. Field reports further suggest a secondary capability: the apparent ability to “download” information through touch, which would explain her uncanny awareness of classified operations.
Her demeanor is consistently arrogant, she openly taunts capture teams.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Faraday: Freely control and generate electricity within 450m radius. - Zero: Nullify one law in 50m radius.

objects.title: Blitzherr: The Mortician
objects.text:
Subject Ger-09, Lightning Lord.
Whatever fuels this man’s mindset remains unknown, whatever it is.. He is a battle-driven fanatic, perpetually seeking opponents capable of pushing him to his absolute limit. 
To date, only Lucy and Shunya have provided confrontations he deemed “worthy,” and he was defeated in both encounters, facts he recounts with excitement rather than shame.
His phenomena grant him extensive control over electricity across a notably wide radius, enabling him to erase evidence, neutralize threats, or eradicate any compromised areas within mere seconds. 
If that wasn't enough, He also can cancel out a physical law of his choosing within 50m radius with no ill effect to reality.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Manifold: Strength to hurl buildings and flight speed upto 400kmph. - Third eye: delete anything within its sight.

objects.title: Shunya: The Calamity
objects.text:
Subject In-0, designated Shunya.
She stands as the single most destructive one humanity has produced.
Her primary phenomenon is a form of tactile telekinesis, allowing controlled flight, overwhelming strength to effortlessly hurl multi-ton structures as though they were weightless props. Under normal circumstances that alone would qualify her as a significant threat easily.
But there is more..
Once per day, she may manifest a third eye upon her forehead. Anything that enters its field of vision simply ceases to exist, erased without trace or residue.
Our continued safety hinges solely on one factor: Shunya is, by temperament, a pacifist.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Spin: Rotates the world around him in anyway he wants. - Mist: Can generate thick fog in mere seconds.

objects.title: Orun: The Jester
objects.text:
Subject A-03, commonly referred to as Orun.
Unlike most Espers, his allegiance is… unconventional. He does not act for any single nation. Instead, Operating for entire African continent, a stance that has complicated diplomatic discussions more than once.
Orun may designate a radius around himself, and every object within that region starts spinning around him like a pivot point, their personal momentum nullified.
They remain locked in position relative to him, regardless of attempts to escape, while he freely adjusts the spin’s speed, direction, and duration.
Orun himself displays an almost bored temperament, often appearing indifferent to the chaos he causes.

addons.title: Phenomena:
addons.text: - Femme: Makes anyone attracted to women unable to harm her. - Catatonia: Petrify via touch - Edit: edit memories via touch

objects.title: Belle Mort: The Warden
objects.text:
Subject Fr-01, designated Belle Morte.
A translation of “beautiful death,” and in this case, a regrettably accurate name.
Her primary phenomenon manifests as an extreme form of charm induction.
Any individual with even a smallest attraction to femininity becomes incapable of sustaining hostile intent toward her, their judgment softened, their resistance notably diminished. In operational contexts, this has resulted in a concerning number of irrational field decisions.
Through direct touch, Belle Morte can induce rapid petrification as well as overwrite up to twelve hours of a target’s recent memory. Both effects are exceptionally difficult to counter once initiated.

rows.title: Your Targets
rows.titleText: “Very well. Now that your team has been accounted for, it’s time to assign targets.” “Several nations..predictably answered the call of alien DNA and produced their own Espers. Now with the threat a single esper possess, That kind of weapon can't be left unchecked. You cannot kill espers, That's not an option for us, What we can do.. is to have countermeasures" “Your squad will be paired with two notable threats. You will be the leash meant to be keep them in check" Familiarize yourself with any two

objects.title: Financial support
objects.text: In return for compliance, the Foundation will discreetly improve your family’s standard of living through indirect means such as charities and subsidies. On average, their quality of life will increase by 256%, without revealing your survival or our involvement.

objects.title: Panacea
objects.text: You will be granted access to medical facilities unavailable to the public. Each year, you may nominate up to two individuals to receive treatment capable of curing serious conditions ranging from cancer to otherwise incurable diseases.

objects.title: Abode
objects.text: In place of standard quarters, you will be assigned a private residence. The house will be spacious, furnished to your preferences, regularly stocked with essentials, and equipped with technology comparable to a modern suburban home.

objects.title: Veto
objects.text: For a limited number of instances per year that scales with your rank in organization, you have the authority to refuse an assigned mission without repercussions, provided you submit a reasonable justification for non-participation.

objects.title: Off-day
objects.text: You may designate one day each week for sanctioned leave. You are permitted to exit the facility and engage with civilian environments. Basic expenses will be covered to allow leisure activities such as dining, entertainment, or travel within limits.

objects.title: Companion
objects.text: You may select one common household animal. Using your DNA, we will engineer a hybrid companion assigned exclusively to you. The organism will be biologically immortal and may express a weakened variant of one of your abilities. It can only be fed by a serum only we can make.

objects.title: Agenda
objects.text: A limited number of times per year, you may submit a personal request for an operation or objective of your choosing. The Foundation will allocate resources and funding to ensure its execution, however no esper will be assigned besides you.

objects.title: Immunity
objects.text: While most espers operate beyond law, you are specially exempt from civilian and military jurisdiction. No nation may legally detain, interrogate, or act against you without breaching multiple international accords and inviting severe retaliation.

objects.title: Consumption
objects.text: You may request any consumable items intended for personal enjoyment. This includes media, cuisine of the highest grade, and approved recreational substances, provided no active mission or operational readiness period is in effect.

objects.title: Therapy
objects.text: One of the most frequently requested provisions. You will be assigned a dedicated therapist, with sessions conducted three times a week, focused on psychological stability, long-term mental health, and functional well-being.

objects.title: Hobby
objects.text:
You may pursue any hobby of your choosing. We will provide the necessary funding, tools, and support for said hobby. Whether it is art supplies for drawing, Books for reading, a laptop for animation..
All equipment is provided upon requests.

objects.title: Oracle
objects.text: You will be granted access to the Foundation’s full knowledge database. This includes Project ESPER records, data on other espers, and classified governmental info. Access to files concerning senior leadership remains restricted, for obvious reasons.

rows.title: Benefits
rows.titleText: “Now that most matters are settled, one question remains... Why would a god cooperate with ants? The answer is simple. Ants own the world the god walks upon. So long as you cooperate, we will provide benefits beyond standard provisions such as food, shelter, and routine cover‑ups. Go rogue, and all of it is withdrawn. At that point, you will stand alone, marked as a target by every nation on the planet.” Choose upto 3 benefits

objects.text: Q1: So can our powers grow stronger over time? The teammates you showed had different power levels, different range from us. ? With the sole exception of your evolution, Phenomena do not “grow.” What you have is what you get. Refinement is possible: technique, efficiency, perhaps a marginal extension of range but the core remains unchanged. The discrepancy among your teammates is not evidence of growth, It is variance in the initial manifestation. Some were simply born with a stronger expression than you. Others, weaker. Q2:Why are all the base phenomena so limited and weak? Besides Evolutions and Redacted powers, they barely seem useful. That’s because they aren’t meant to be flashy weapons. Base phenomena are supernatural occurrences the Esper can trigger at will, mostly for convenience. Think of them as tools in an arsenal rather than the main artillery- helpful, occasionally clever, but not something you’d lead a war with. Q3: Why are points so limited? I can’t buy X without compromising Y. The alien carcass could, in theory, load you up with far more potential than you currently enjoy. The issue is your biology. Human bodies crack under the strain..mutating, degrading, and eventually producing those delightful monsters we have to waste bullets on. Trust me, you don’t want to end up in that pile. As for your dilemma... No man is an island, remember? The system is designed so you’ll depend on your squadmates, filling in gaps where you lack. Q4: How does evolution work? It seems to hold a different place in the hierarchy than the rest? Evolution is the one phenomenon that actually feels like it belongs to you. No awkward trial-and-error, no fumbling with controls. It slips on like a second skin to your soul. With repetition, training, and a bit of stubbornness, you may expand its range, shorten its cooldown, amplify its force, whatever axis you decide to sharpen. But temper your expectations: the growth curve is steep at first and then mercilessly levels off. A plateau is inevitable. Still, by the time you slam face-first into it, you will already rank among the most dangerous entities walking this planet. Q5: Why do redacted powers get no evolutions? And why are they even in a separate category from the rest? Redacted powers… let’s be honest, we barely understand them. Most of these allow the user to manipulate space-time in some fashion. Because of this, they’re already comparable to an evolution in sheer potential. And, between you and me… if one of these can literally halt time for the entire universe, I do NOT want to see what its evolution would do. Q6: What's stopping me from spamming my time powers with clones or make a super powerful Tulpa with average? it won't work.. Redacted powers refuse to cooperate with any Tulpa generated via Eidolon. Our current theory is that these abilities require a component that exists only within the original Esper’s body, Something no clone or projection can replicate. The precise nature of this component is unknown, and attempts to bypass it are… futile on our part... Q7: How does Adaptation even work? Can it just protect me from anything and everything? Could I adapt to other Espers, or even dimensions? Wow, You're one delusional person... No, Adaptation doesn’t make you the universe’s golden child. As far as we’ve observed, it only engages when the environment itself would make you unfit to survive or function. Drop you on the surface of the sun, and it works. But if another Esper decides to launch a fire tornado at you? Adaptation sits that one out. See the distinction? It’s there to let you operate in hostile conditions, not to turn you into some invincible god-thing. Q8: How does Phenomenal Dissonance work? It says it protects us from other phenomena, but clearly some abilities still get through. What gives? Think of it like this: the effect makes it much harder for hostile powers to hit you directly, but it doesn’t make you untouchable. If another Esper throws a building at you with telekinesis, the building still lands but trying to grab you with the same telekinesis is by far more difficult. Same for telepathy: surface thoughts in the room might still be picked up with slight effort, but digging into your mind specifically is way tougher. Same for masking: You can still be fooled by it but if the user does too many abnormal changes to location, You will pick up on them earlier than others. The big exception? Direct violation of your vessel. Mind control, Disintegration, ripping apart limbs.. things like that are nullified outright. Q9: So with Array… can I step into different realities and just stay there? Could I go into a fictional universe and fetch some magic item? I understand the enthusiasm, but sadly no. Arrays only reach into timelines where history branched differently, alternate pasts, shifted probabilities. No new physics, no magic, nothing that exciting. And before you ask.. no, you can’t bring loot back, Only your body passes through. There are strange cases though. In one branch, there is some entity that makes supernatural deals with humanity... On contact with an Esper, It... fled away in absolute terror. The Esper wasn’t doing anything threatening. Why it ran? We don’t know.. Q10: So how many Espers are there? Can we just make infinite Espers? If only... Each awakening requires alien DNA and more of it just to keep you stable long enough to grow into something useful. And seeing as the donor is a corpse, the supply is… finite. By our projections, the absolute ceiling is about 500 Espers worldwide, accounting for resources wasted on failed espers. Right now, every nation combined has produced roughly 54% of that. So no, we can’t make infinite Espers. Be flattered , You’re a limited edition.

rows.title: Frequently asked questions
rows.titleText:
I'm sure you have lots of questions..
Tho I'm not in any mood to answer them, I'm demanded by my higher ups to clear all doubts for our 'new soldier'

objects.text: Q1: Weren’t you in some other universe? What are you doing here? What happened to that world? It seems you are aware of that reality. Yes.. I was opposed and undone by my counterpart. You may call it Fang, the god of flesh. That branch of existence is no longer what you would recognize. Fang has overwritten it, folding every living thing into its domain. Thought was stripped away, leaving only instinct and hunger. Q2: Just curious..Can we develop powers to create golems or generate sentient life? No. I will not permit the creation of sentient minds. This is not a question of capability, the mechanics exist within reach, but of choice. New consciousnesses are not toys to be manufactured, I prefer not to have any completion. Q3: What will happen to us after this war? Espers seem effectively eternal, Do we just keep existing forever? In theory, you should. But you will not. Your existence will end. Not today, not even within this millennium. But one day… Your days are numbered. Q4: So what happens to you? Are you just going to continue existing inside our heads? Not really. In the far future, when your homeworld has succumbed to the death of its star, and all of you drift through empty space… I shall reawaken. I will reclaim all fragments of myself, the human experiences, the refinements forged through your powers, your knowledge and memories.. All will be absorbed to strengthen my next emergence, Which will trigger heat death of this universe. But I'm sure nothing of value shall be lost. Q5: Hold on… HOLD ON!? Are we going to die? Not in the sense you fear. Once all fragments are absorbed, your human vessel will cease. Your mind, however, will persist within me, alongside your kin and those who came before. You will feel no pain, no suffering, just peace Your sense of self will be preserved, I will ensure it endures. Q6: Why do some phenomena feel completely useless in combat? They all are not meant to be weapons. Think of them as tools, situational advantages or conveniences. Some tools are very handy for destructive purposes, Some tools are good for communicating, Some for movement, Some for information, like that. Not everything you can trigger exists to punch a hole in someone’s skull.
